It seeks full exposure to XRP by holding near-term XRP futures and rolling them forward before expiry.

name: Volatility Shares Trust XRP 2X ETF
summary: The Volatility Shares Trust XRP 2X ETF is a leveraged fund seeking twice the daily price returns tied to XRP futures contracts on CFTC-registered exchanges, backed by collateral such as cash or high-quality securities. It reaches 2x daily participation using near-expiry XRP futures, rolled before expiration.

name: VegaShares Space & AI ETF
summary: The Fund’s investment objective is to seek capital appreciation. VegaShares Space & AI ETF is an exchange-traded fund listed on the Nasdaq Global Market under the ticker XSPC and traded in USD. The fund is part of the VegaShares range. It is classified as Information Technology (Developed Markets).

name: NEOS Boosted S&P 500 High Income ETF
summary: The NEOS Boosted S&P 500® High Income ETF (the “Fund”) seeks to boost performance by generating high monthly income in a tax efficient manner with the potential for enhanced equity appreciation in rising markets.

name: iShares Exponential Technologies ETF
summary:
The investment seeks to track the investment results of the Morningstar® Exponential Technologies IndexSM which composed of stocks of developed and emerging market companies that create or use exponential technologies.
 The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is a subset of the Morningstar US Market Index and the Morningstar Global Markets ex-US Index family.

name: MarketDesk International Momentum ETF
summary: The MarketDesk International Momentum ETF (the “Fund”) seeks long-term capital appreciation. MarketDesk International Momentum ETF is an exchange-traded fund listed on the Nasdaq Global Market under the ticker XUSM and traded in USD. The fund is part of the MarketDesk range. It is classified as Equities (Factors).

name: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 and XRP 75/25 Strategy ETF
summary: The CYBER HORNET S&P 500 ® and XRP 75/25 Strategy ETF (the “Fund”) seeks to replicate, before fees and expenses, the total return of the S&P 500 ® and S&P XRP 75/25 Blend Index (the “Index”), an index by Standard & Poor’s.

name: Leverage Shares 2X Long XYZ Daily ETF
summary: The Fund is an exchange traded fund (“ETF”) that seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of XYZ. The Fund does not seek to achieve its stated investment objective for a period of time different than a trading day.

name: GraniteShares YieldBoost Single Stock Universe ETF
summary: The GraniteShares YieldBoost Single Stock Universe ETF aims first to supply steady current income and second to offer access to a varied set of YieldBoost exchange-traded funds. It invests in selected high-yielding products from within the GraniteShares fund family.

name: GraniteShares YieldBoost TopYielders ETF
summary: The GraniteShares YieldBoost TopYielders ETF primarily aims to generate current income, with a secondary goal of gaining exposure to a curated group of YieldBoost ETFs. It pursues these goals by investing in YieldBoost strategies.

name: ClearBridge Dividend Strategy ESG ETF
summary:
The investment seeks dividend income, growth of dividend income and long-term capital appreciation.
 Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, if any, in dividend-paying stocks or other instruments with similar economic characteristics that offer the potential for income growth and capital appreciation over time and that meet its financial and environmental, social and governance ("ESG") criteria. The fund may also invest in companies that the subadviser believes are making substantial progress toward becoming a leader in ESG policies.

name: Horizon Digital Frontier ETF
summary: The Horizon Digital Frontier ETF (the “Digital Frontier Fund” or the “Fund”) seeks capital appreciation. Horizon Digital Frontier ETF is an exchange-traded fund listed on the Nasdaq Global Market under the ticker YNOT and traded in USD.

name: YOKE Core ETF
summary: The Yoke Core ETF (the “Fund”) seeks to achieve capital appreciation. YOKE Core ETF is an exchange-traded fund listed on the Nasdaq Global Market under the ticker YOKE and traded in USD.

name: YieldMax Short N100 Option Income Strategy ETF
summary: The Fund’s primary investment objective is to seek current income. The Fund’s secondary investment objective is to seek inverse (opposite) exposure to the performance of the Nasdaq 100 Index (the “Index”), subject to a limit on potential investment gains.

name: YieldMax Memory and Storage Portfolio Option Income ETF
summary: The Fund’s primary investment objective is to seek current income. The Fund’s secondary investment objective is to seek capital appreciation. YieldMax Memory and Storage Portfolio Option Income ETF is an exchange-traded fund listed on the Nasdaq Global Market under the ticker YRAM and traded in USD. The fund is part of the YieldMax ETFs range. It is classified as Derivatives (Large Cap).

name: GraniteShares YieldBOOST SPY ETF
summary: The Fund’s primary investment objective is to achieve 3 times (300%) the income generated from selling options on the S&P 500 ® Index (the “Underlying Index”) by selling options on leveraged exchange-traded funds designed to deliver 3 times (300%) the daily performance of the Underlying Index (the “Underlying Leveraged ETF”). The Fund’s secondary investment objective is to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying Leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains. A downside protection may be implemented which could affect the net income level.

name: Global X U.S. Electrification ETF
summary: The Global X U.S. Electrification ETF (the "Fund") seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Global X U.S. Electrification Index (the "Underlying Index").
